principles: Backward-compatible default: no change-scope provided => identical behavior to today (full recursive tsc)
Reuse the established injectable git-diff-vs-main reader seam from validate-concept.ts rather than inventing a new resolution path
Change-scope is an additive optional input threaded through checkLint->runTsc, not a mutation of the TSCONFIG_IGNORE_DIRS module constant
Out-of-scope packages missing node_modules are skipped-with-warning; in-scope packages still hard-fail on real tsc errors
Tests exercise the CommandRunner DI seam only; never spawn real tsc
drivers: A backend-only change in a fresh worktree must not be blocked by unrelated frontend missing-dep TS2307 errors
REVIEW->TEST lint gate must still catch real type errors in the packages the story actually changed
Must not regress the B-5a28 recursive-tsc coverage that catches monorepo subpackage errors when no story scope is given

options.name: scoped-skip-additive
pros: Targets the exact failure: out-of-scope package missing deps becomes skipped-with-warning
Reuses git-diff-vs-main reader; testable via CommandRunner + injectable diff reader
In-scope packages keep hard-failing on real errors (gate still bites)
cons: Adds a package-root resolution helper + changed-file diff reader
More branches in runTsc to test (in-scope fail, out-of-scope skip, no-scope full)

options.name: skip-any-deps-missing
cons: Silently stops type-checking any deps-missing package even when it IS the changed package => gate stops biting on real in-scope errors

options.name: filter-to-changed-only
cons: No-scope path must still run all (ok) or regresses to none
Installed out-of-scope packages no longer checked, reducing defense-in-depth vs B-5a28

rationale: scoped-skip-additive (optional changedFiles + package-root mapping + scoped skip for out-of-scope+deps-absent) is the only option that fixes the reported failure while preserving backward compatibility (no scope => full recursive tsc, B-5a28 intact) and keeping the gate biting on real type errors in the changed packages. skip-any-deps-missing over-skips (kills the in-scope gate); filter-to-changed-only risks under-checking installed out-of-scope packages and complicates the no-scope path. The chosen option reuses the proven git-diff-vs-main injectable reader from validate-concept.ts, testable through the existing CommandRunner DI seam with zero real tsc spawns.

preMortem.scenario: Out-of-scope skip is applied even when no change-scope was provided
preMortem.trigger: checkLint called with projectRoot only (plain --lint, no story)
preMortem.consequence: B-5a28 recursive coverage silently regresses; subpackage type errors stop being caught
preMortem.mitigation: Skip logic activates only when a non-empty changedFiles set is passed; absent/empty scope => full recursive tsc unchanged. Smoke test asserts the no-scope path still runs every tsconfig.

preMortem.scenario: An in-scope package with genuinely missing deps gets skipped instead of failing
preMortem.trigger: changed package also lacks node_modules and code treats deps-absent as skip regardless of scope
preMortem.consequence: Real type errors in the changed code slip past the gate (false green)
preMortem.mitigation: Deps-absent skip-with-warning is gated on out-of-scope only; in-scope packages keep existing ENOENT(skip) vs non-zero-exit(fail) semantics. Smoke test: in-scope tsc fail still surfaces as kind:fail.

preMortem.scenario: Package-root resolution misattributes a changed file to the wrong tsconfig
preMortem.trigger: nested tsconfigs or a changed file not under any package.json
preMortem.consequence: A changed package is wrongly treated as out-of-scope (under-check) or vice versa
preMortem.mitigation: A changed file is in-scope for a tsconfig if it lives under that tsconfig directory subtree. Ambiguous => treat as in-scope (fail-closed, never silently skip). Smoke test covers a changed file under backend tsconfig dir + one under frontend.

preMortem.scenario: git diff reader throws (no main base / detached HEAD) and code crashes or defaults to skip-all
preMortem.consequence: Gate crashes or wrongly scopes everything out
preMortem.mitigation: Mirror validate-concept.ts: on diff failure fall back to full recursive tsc (scope unknown => check everything), never skip-all. Injectable reader lets the smoke test simulate failure.
